title: IVG Savr 3000 Grape Ice Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Grape Ice IVG Savr 3000 Prefilled Pods deliver a punchy, sweet Grape flavour with a streak of cool Menthol on the exhale. It’s a striking yet balanced blend with a juicy fruit core and brisk finish. Each refill includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a 4ml refill reservoir. Once assembled, the refill system keeps the pod topped up as you vape — no refilling or coil changes needed. Mesh coil technology enhances flavour and vapour production, while the click-fit assembly and pod detection make setup simple and secure. For use with the IVG Savr 3000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up IVG Savr Prefilled Pod's Step 1: Unpack the Device Remove the cap from the mouthpiece. Take out the silicone stopper from the pod. Step 2: Prepare the Refill Peel off the red sticker. Remove the rubber stop. Step 3: Connect the Pod Align the refill with the pod. Press until you hear a click. Step 4: Insert into Device Slide the full pod-and-refill unit into the Savr device. Step 5: Prime the Coil Wait a few minutes to let the coil fully saturate. ✅ Ready to Vape! Inhale to activate and enjoy.
